description: Add a new website, API, or webshop target for monitoring with full onboarding. Automatically enables compatible tests, triggers an initial scan, and captures a page screenshot. Requires write scope (Free plan: 1 target). Use analyze_target first to detect platform and get test recommendations.

type.description: Target type: WEBSITE, API, or WEBSHOP. Use analyze_target to auto-detect.

weight.description: Business weight, used to rank findings by consequence: REVENUE_PATH (checkout, payment, signup), PUBLIC (customer-visible but not transactional), INTERNAL (staging, admin tooling).

name: create_target
title: Create Target
